description: This file contains a report script for generating a bank reconciliation statement in the ERPNext system, including functions to fetch and process financial transaction data, compute balances, and generate report columns.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the bank reconciliation report.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches journal entries, payment entries, and POS transactions related to the specified account and date.

methods.name: get_amounts_not_reflected_in_system
methods.description: Calculates amounts not reflected in the system for the given filters.

methods.name: get_balance_row
methods.description: Creates a balance row dictionary for the report based on label, amount, and currency.
